subject: Continuity validation — key-personnel matrix & RTO substantiation
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@harborbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Harbor Bank Audit <audit@harborbank.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO substantiation + key-personnel continuity matrix

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Harbor Bank's Compliance team is running a focused continuity review for our cloud vendors and has asked for two specific items to close their SOC2 evidence bundle:

1) A short RTO/RPO substantiation document showing the measured recovery times for critical inference routes (examples: model API, KV cache restore, token billing pipeline). If you have a single-page summary (with test dates and observed timings) that would be ideal.

2) A key-personnel continuity matrix and on-call roster that shows who is responsible for failover, runbook execution, and who is authorized to approve failover or capacity changes during an incident. They asked this to validate replacement/backup coverage.

Can you provide these artifacts (PDF or spreadsheet) and a target delivery date? Also flag any parts of the data that are sensitive and require an NDA or secure transfer link.

Lisa Chen
Senior IT Risk Manager — Harbor Bank
Lisa.Chen@harborbank.com

(Attachment requested: Harbor_Bank_BCP_Request_20261108.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@harborbank.com>
Cc: Harbor Bank Audit <audit@harborbank.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO substantiation + key-personnel continuity matrix

Lisa —

Thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the request doc. We can get you both artifacts. High-level delivery plan:

- Today EOD: high-level RTO/RPO one-pager (test dates + observed timings) and a filled key-personnel matrix (redacted emails for public copies).
- Tomorrow: full supporting artifacts (runbook excerpts, test logs, on-call roster CSV) delivered securely via shared Drive link or SFTP depending on your preference.

Quick note on sensitivity: on-call roster will include personal phone numbers — we can provide a redacted public copy and a secure copy for Harbor's audit team.

I'll coordinate with Ops to pull the measured timings from our latest failover rehearsals (10/14 and 09/02) and confirm any variance. If Harbor needs format preferences for SIG/CAIQ attachment, let me know and we'll map fields accordingly.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(Attachment: none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: RTO/RPO substantiation + key-personnel continuity matrix

Team — forwarding Harbor Bank's ask. Action items:

- Priyom: can you pull the measured RTO/RPO timings from the 2026-10-14 tabletop and the 2026-09-02 warm-standby failover? I need a single-page summary with the following columns: component, expected RTO, observed RTO, RPO (if applicable), test date, short notes. Attach any relevant logs or test run IDs.

- Laura: please produce a key-personnel continuity matrix and on-call roster for Q4 (CSV + redacted PDF). Include primary, secondary, tertiary for each role: on-call eng, infra lead, SRE runbook owner, incident commander. Mark any authorized approvers for capacity changes.

- Both: flag anything that should be redacted for the public deliverable. Harbor wants a public copy and a secure copy for their auditors.

On timeline — Ben to Harbor: we should have the public copy by EOD today and the secure bundle by tomorrow mid-day.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben —

Attached are the artifacts I pulled for the one-page RTO/RPO summary and the ops runbook excerpt. Short notes:

- redwood_rto_summary_v2.pdf (one-page): includes measured times for API cold-start (KV rehydration), KV cache restore, and control-plane failover. Observed RTOs: API KV rehyration 22s (10/14/2026), model endpoint restore 3m45s (09/02/2026 warm-standby), billing pipeline replay 4m10s (10/14/2026).
- runbook-summary-ops.md: excerpted runbook steps for automatic prefix cache rehydration and incident escalation flow.
- test logs: linked in the document (internal test IDs T-20261014-RTO-001, T-20260902-WARM-002).

I've redacted phone numbers on the roster; the oncall_roster_q4_2026.csv attached is the redacted public CSV. Full roster with contact numbers is available in the secure Drive folder.

Attachments (stub): redwood_rto_summary_v2.pdf, runbook-summary-ops.md, oncall_roster_q4_2026.csv

Let me know if you want any additional metrics (p95 latency during warm-start, KV cache hit ratios during restore).

—Priyom
Senior Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@harborbank.com>, Harbor Bank Audit <audit@harborbank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Deliverables: RTO/RPO one-pager + key-personnel matrix (Harbor Bank)

Lisa / Harbor Audit Team —

Attached are the requested public-purpose artifacts for your SOC2 continuity bundle:

- redwood_rto_summary_v2.pdf (one-page RTO/RPO substantiation; includes test dates and observed timings).
- oncall_roster_q4_2026.csv (redacted public roster; personal numbers removed).
- runbook-summary-ops.md (runbook excerpt covering restore steps and incident roles).
- sig-bcp-answers.xlsx (SIG mapping for BCP/DR section — public fields populated; redacted where required).

Secure bundle: we also prepared a secure folder with full logs and contact details. Access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AxyExampleDriveLink (restricted to Harbor audit group). If you prefer SFTP, we can push a password-protected archive — let me know and we'll arrange with InfoSec.

Summary highlights (for quick reviewer reference):
- Recent rehearsals (10/14/2026, tabletop + warm-standby) show primary model endpoint restore typically completes within 4 minutes; KV cache rehydration completes ~20–30s when cache artifacts are warm.
- RTO targets are componentized: API layer 5m, model serving 10m, billing replay 15m. Observed results exceeded target for API/model in both tests.
- On-call coverage: primary/secondary/tertiary for all critical roles. Approval policy for capacity changes requires an incident commander + ops manager sign-off; names listed in secure roster.

If Harbor's audit team would like a short 20-minute walkthrough of the artifacts, Priyom and I are available tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced (stubs): redwood_rto_summary_v2.pdf, oncall_roster_q4_2026.csv, runbook-summary-ops.md, sig-bcp-answers.xlsx
